items.title: Live: First flight bound for Australia as crisis teams deployed for stranded travellers
items.description: The United States and Israel are continuing to launch strikes at Iran as Tehran becomes increasingly isolated after attacking neighbouring countries. Follow live.

items.title: Iran uses kamikaze drone boats for first time in Middle East war
items.description: Iran is using exploding drone boats for the first time in war in the Middle East, hitting an oil tanker near the Strait of Hormuz after ordering the key shipping passage closed.

items.title: Australians likely face price hikes amid Middle East uncertainty, treasurer warns
items.description: Price hikes for Australians are a likely outcome of the economic uncertainty sparked by the conflict in the Middle East, Treasurer Jim Chalmers has warned.

items.title: By striking Gulf states Iran is hitting one of Trump's vulnerabilities
items.description: Despite their immense wealth — and even their past capacity to influence the globe through their control over oil prices — the Gulf states don't have much ability to influence events in this war.

items.title: Grant cancelled for Islamic community group amid 'social cohesion concerns'
items.description: The federal government has cancelled a grant for an Islamic community association in Melbourne citing "social cohesion concerns" after claims surfaced the group was mourning the death of Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

items.title: First flight has left Dubai for Sydney. How do airlines determine it is safe?
items.description: A flight from Dubai to Australia has taken off, becoming the first commercial plane to carry Australians home since the Middle East conflict began.

items.title: The Kyle and Jackie O experiment failed
items.description: The network's mammoth deal banked on the fact that people in Melbourne would take to the hosts just as Sydneysiders did.

items.title: Two members of Gus Lamont's family 'not cooperating' directly with police
items.description: South Australia's Police Commissioner has said that two members of missing boy Gus Lamont's family are "not cooperating" with investigators, but a police spokesperson said they could not comment further on the number of suspects in the case.

items.title: High-profile dentist shot dead by police after allegedly attacking two women
items.description: Steven Lin allegedly attacked two women while armed with a knife inside a Sydney apartment complex before being shot dead by police.

items.title: Unwavering work ethic and energy made Dennis Cometti a sporting icon
items.description: Dennis Cometti was known to viewers as a wordsmith who made rattled off rejoinders with ease, but behind the scenes he worked harder than anyone to carve out a place in Australia's sporting landscape.

items.title: Long queues at servos as petrol prices surge amid Middle East war
items.description: Petrol retailers across the nation are being accused of "unconscionable" behaviour by preying on people's anxieties as fuel prices surge in the midst of the Middle East war.

items.title: Giant gas-fired power station planned for power-hungry AI data centre
items.description: A small town in the NSW Southern Highlands is watching the AI revolution take shape in its backyard, as plans emerge to build one of the state's largest gas-fired power stations to run a data-processing complex.

items.title: After Mosman Park tragedy, father of teen with severe autism rejects tropes
items.description: Simon Lewis knew the Clune family, who died in an apparent murder-suicide last month, and says his own experience with his severely autistic daughter means he can relate "to what they were going through".

items.title: Young Iranian footballer fights tears as she speaks about war in Iran
items.description: On the eve of their Women's Asian Cup match against the Matildas, Iran's women's football team has expressed concern over the plight of their family and friends in Iran as war rages in the Middle East.

items.title: What does it mean if you never remember your dreams?
items.description: Some people are naturally better at recalling their dreams. Others worry they're not getting quality sleep if they can't remember their dreams. Here's the science.

items.title: Blood moon captured from around Australia
items.description: Stargazers across the country have shared photos of the blood moon total lunar eclipse, from the city to the beach and regional backyards — here's a look.

items.title: 'All voices should be heard': Festival presses on after writers exit
items.description: With the potential to be overshadowed by the cancellation of its writers' festival, Adelaide Festival opened over the weekend, bringing together local and international artists.

items.title: Melbourne F1 Grand Prix rebuild sees $115m blowout due to asbestos
items.description: The planned rebuild of a pit lane at Albert Park has blown out by millions of dollars, with Victorian taxpayers to foot the bill.

items.title: CFMEU inquiry suspects Qld company of Victorian underworld ties
items.description: A Queensland business is suspected of ties to Victorian underworld figure Mick Gatto by Queensland's CFMEU Inquiry.

items.title: 'Better off being homeless': Canberra's biggest landlord failing tenants
items.description: The ACT Ombudsman says the ACT government is failing its legal obligations as a landlord after looking into complaints by tenants.

items.title: Body found during search for tourist missing from Gold Coast beach
items.description: Police say emergency services were called after reports a 20-year-old man, who is believed to be a tourist, was seen struggling in the water off Main Beach.

items.title: Man accused of killing Labor identity Tim Picton freed on bail
items.description: Brodie Jake Dewar, 20, who allegedly killed Labor identity Tim Picton after striking him and causing him to fall over, is granted bail by a Perth judge.

items.title: Arrest made in long-running missing persons case of footballer's brother
items.description: Police have made an arrest in relation to the long-running missing persons case of the fraudster brother of a former St Kilda footballer.

items.title: Police officer's ear grazed during fatal shooting in Brisbane's east
items.description: Police were called for a welfare check in an east Brisbane suburb on Tuesday, where a man allegedly holding a knife was shot dead.

items.title: Under 16s should be banned from e-scooters and e-bikes, report says
items.description: The committee has made a total of 28 recommendations covering the issues of safety, the risk of lithium-ion battery fires, the retail of devices, enforcement and community awareness and education.
